title: Complete your order
subtitle: Just three steps: shipping details, payment method and confirmation.

shipping.title: Shipping details
shipping.description: Used to deliver your Ao Dai and to contact you about measurements or alterations.
shipping.emailHint: For order confirmation and delivery updates
shipping.notesPlaceholder: E.g. deliver during office hours, call before delivery…

payment.title: Payment method
payment.description: Choose how you would like to pay for your order.

COD.title: Cash on delivery (COD)
COD.description: Pay the courier in cash after receiving and checking your piece.

BANK_TRANSFER.title: Full bank transfer (VietQR)
BANK_TRANSFER.description: Scan the VietQR code on the thank-you page — amount and reference are pre-filled.

DEPOSIT.title: 30–50% deposit, balance on delivery
DEPOSIT.description: Transfer a deposit by VietQR so we can cut the fabric; pay the rest when it arrives.

payment.tailoredNote: Your order includes a made-to-measure piece, so 100% cash on delivery is not available: the fabric is cut to your measurements. Choose a deposit or a full transfer.
payment.qrNote: A VietQR code (with the amount and “THIENCANH <order code>” filled in) appears right after you place the order.

review.title: Review your order
review.description: Please check your details before placing the order.
review.customNote: Your order has made-to-measure items: the tailor double-checks measurements before cutting. You can edit them from the tracking link until the fabric is cut.
review.agreement: By clicking “Place order”, you agree to Thiên Canh's purchase and return policies.
review.qrAfter: The transfer QR code appears on the thank-you page after you place the order.

summary.title: Your order
summary.thanks: Thank you for choosing Thiên Canh
summary.discountNotApplied: Bag discount codes are not applied to online orders yet — the atelier will contact you if a promotion applies.

empty.title: Nothing to check out yet
empty.description: Your cart is empty. Pick the designs you love before checking out.
